title: Server Side Roles
description: A few new roles with unique effects!
body:
Add a few custom roles, most with functionality that are gained when you log on.

# Currently finished: 
- Plauge Doctor
- Mayor

## Plauge Doctor: 
Find and cure all medical issues including:

### End Virus
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Gained by touching the Ender Dragon egg, cured with one of the four Unknown Remedies.

</details>

### Plague

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Randomly spreads to animals and can cause coughing and you can even die to it. No Cure.

</details>

### Altitude Sickess

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Can Cause Dizziness and blindness if you are too low in the world for too long. Cured by being above y=60 for a few minutes.

</details>

### Fungle

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Causes dizziness and blindess, spreads by touch. Has a fungle cure(also a Unknown Remedie)

</details>

## Mayor: 
Run for the Mayor on your server, convince people you should rule!

## Chaos Weaver: 
Cause as much chaos as humanly possible, you are trying to do this while avoiding the mayors!

## Assasin: 
Kill the Mayor! THat is your goal, figure out who they are and eliminate them!

## Human: 
Nothing has changed, and you are just a normal player!
